description: This header file declares interfaces for WAN Manager inter-process communication (IPC), including function prototypes for sending messages, starting the IPC server, forcing DHCPv6 renewal, and setting interface status, along with necessary include directives and conditional compilation.

methods.name: WanMgr_SendMsgToIHC
methods.description: Sends a message to the IHC (IPOE Health Check) component using the specified message type and interface name. Conditionally declared if FEATURE_IPOE_HEALTH_CHECK is defined.

methods.name: WanMgr_StartIpcServer
methods.description: Starts the IPC server to handle WAN Manager clients.

methods.name: Wan_ForceRenewDhcpIPv6
methods.description: Forces renewal of DHCPv6 lease on the specified interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_SetInterfaceStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the specified network interface.
